_doc: Site change log. Append a new entry every time we touch a mascot record, swap a photo, change a credit, or add/remove a store. Powers the unified feed on /recent. Newest entries should be at the TOP of the array. Schema: { date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind, store_number?, mascot_id?, summary, reason? }. Allowed kinds: 'added' | 'renamed' | 'photo' | 'credit' | 'notes' | 'store_added' | 'store_removed' | 'site'.

events.summary: Easter egg launched: McQuackers' Quest at /terms
events.reason: Tucked a hidden-object game behind the boring 'Terms and Conditions' footer link. Scroll past the first section and McQuackers crashes through the page — then you guide him through 5 real Trader Joe's stores (West Hollywood, Lake Grove, East Liberty Pittsburgh, Silverdale, Rochester) to find their actual cataloged mascots: Steven Sparkles, Schmooli, Tuskanini, Confetti Yeti, Susan Bee Anthony. All art hand-painted via Higgsfield AI in vintage Fearless Flyer style. Time-based scoring, optional hints, global leaderboard with 3-letter initials, brag-share URLs. Also reachable directly at /quack.

events.summary: Database security hardened — RLS gap closed, all advisor warnings resolved
events.reason: Supabase flagged that the submissions and corrections tables had policies but RLS itself was disabled, meaning the policies weren’t being enforced and anyone with the public anon key could read or modify those tables. Enabled RLS on both, then went on to clear every other security advisory: REVOKE'd REST execute on the two trigger functions, pinned a search_path on touch_updated_at, dropped the broad listing policy on the mascot-photos bucket, and tightened the three public-facing INSERT policies with size caps and forced pending-status. Site is now clean on Supabase’s security linter (zero findings).
Crew badge in the new photo clearly reads ‘JOE JOE — Crew Member.’ The earlier ‘Jo-Jo’ spelling was a transcription error.

events.reason: Pepper the Platypus had babies — and a ‘puggle’ is the proper term for a platypus pup. The new photo is a holiday family portrait with all three of them in matching knit sweaters.
New autumn-themed shot with a scarecrow and felt pumpkin. Also cleaned up the file extension from .png → .jpg.

Shaggy ape build + bandolier strap across the chest + the name ‘Chewy’ all point to Chewbacca the Wookiee. Listing the species as Sasquatch (real-world cousin) since Wookiee is a fictional Star Wars species.

events.summary: Removed Denver Hilltop wine-shop sibling #310 — duplicate of grocery #300
events.reason: Pre-2019 Colorado law capped a grocery chain at one full-liquor-license store statewide, so TJ ran a co-located wine shop right next door (lat/lng within ~75 ft of the grocery). Removing #310 keeps the map honest. Same pattern as the three Kentucky wine shops we removed earlier.

events.summary: Unified Store # display: red pill across all listings
events.reason: Yorktown #567 ‘no mascot yet’ card was showing the store number in plain bold text while Elk Grove #190 (with mascot) showed it in a red pill. Now consistent across the popup card, /city, and /state pages.

Hamburger button was clipping off the right edge on 390-pixel-wide phones. Added a finer ≤400px breakpoint that shrinks the duck logo, wordmark, search-bar minimum width, and hamburger size to give everything breathing room.
